source_kind: derived governed aggregate over policy-controlled local datasets
ownership: Each field remains governed by its named upstream source and policy; this publisher owns only the aggregate transformation and view contract.
allowed_use: aggregate national, state, county, ZIP, and source visibility
prohibited_use: representing the views as a complete census of active U.S. businesses
representing source-specific status as universal current operating status
publishing source-preserving profile counts as deduplicated business counts
allocating ZIP business counts to counties with polygon-area weights
allocating Census Nonemployer Statistics to ZIPs or ZCTAs
representing annual Nonemployer aggregates as named businesses or current operating status
forcing ambiguous boundary points into one county
public export before every dependency policy and entity-resolution precision gate authorizes it
attribution: Retain exact dependency dataset IDs, release IDs, manifest SHA-256 digests, transformation version, observation ranges, and count semantics.
retention: Keep aggregate releases with immutable dependency hashes; dependency record-level retention remains governed by each source policy.
redistribution: Local aggregate review required. No public redistribution is authorized by this derived policy alone.
personal_data_handling: The publisher emits aggregate counts and geography identifiers only; it does not copy names, street addresses, identifiers, or source profile records into state, county, national, source, or gap views.
